text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain to host a Russian trade exhibition this year.
- Gulf Cooperation Council ministers agree to set up a panel to help them achieve unified tariffs.
- Bahrain calls on Turkey to withdraw its military forces from Iraq and consider its relations with the Arab world.
- A free trade agreement between Gulf Arab states and the European Union will be concluded before the end of next year.
- About 450 businessmen from Gulf Arab states are expected to attend a two-day seminar on new manufacturing investment opportunities in Bahrain.
- Bahrain congratulates the newly elected Iranian president and wishes him success in his duties.
